1.   Call to Order
      Councilman Lovato called the Finance Committee meeting to order at 4:30 pm
2.   Attendance
      Present: Streetman (arrived at 4:43 pm), Lovato, Shakeenab and Zacharias
      Absent: Peters
      Also Present: Mayor Pitts
3.   Approval of Minutes
      Councilman Zacharias made a motion to adopt the March 23, 2026 minutes.
      Councilman Shakeenab seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the motion
      passed.

5.   Committee Action Required
      Councilman Zacharias made a motion to approve; Councilman Shakeenab seconded
      the motion. A voice vote was taken and the motion passed (Councilman Lovato was a
      no vote).
     A.   New Positions - Cities for Financial Empowerment Grant - Clarksville Financial
          Empowerment Center: Michelle Austin



6.   City Council Action Required


     A.   ORDINANCE 67-2025-26 (First Reading) An Ordinance authorizing the exercise
          of the right of eminent domain to acquire easements and rights of way for utility
          improvements required to facilitate design and construction of various projects. Gas
          & Water Board: Approval
              Councilman Shakeenab made a motion to approve Ordinance 67-2025-25 (First
              Reading); Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken
              and the motion passed.

     B.   ORDINANCE 68-2025-26 (First Reading) An Ordinance approving the
          conveyance of certain real property from the City of Clarksville, Tennessee to the
          Clarksville Montgomery County Museum. Mayor Joe Pitts
             Councilman Shakeenab made a motion to approve Ordinance 68-2025-25 (First
             Reading); Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken
             and the motion passed.

     C.   RESOLUTION 55-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing an interlocal agreement
          between the City of Clarksville, TN and Montgomery County TN pertaining to utility
          relocation at the intersection of Rossview Rd and Rollow Ln. Gas & Water Board:
          Approval
              Councilman Shakeenab made a motion to approve Resolution 55-2025-26;
              Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the
              motion passed.

     D.   RESOLUTION 56-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing a memorandum of
          understanding between the City of Clarksville, Tennessee and the Clarksville Arts &
          Heritage Development Council.
             Councilman Lovato made a motion to approve Resolution 56-2025-26;
             Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the
             motion passed.

     E.   RESOLUTION 60-2025-26 Initial Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to
          exceed $42,500,000 in aggregate principal amount of one or more series of general
          obligation bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee
              Councilman Shakeenab made a motion to approve Resolution 60-2025-26;
              Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the
              motion passed.

     F.   RESOLUTION 61-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to exceed
          $42,500,000 in aggregate principal amount of one or more series of general
          obligation bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee, authorizing the issuance of
          bond anticipation notes prior to the issuance of the bonds in an amount not to
          exceed the maximum aggregate principal amount of said bonds; making provision
          for the issuance, sale and payment of said bonds and notes; establishing the terms
          thereof and the disposition of proceeds therefrom; and providing for the levy of
          taxes for the payment of debt service and the bods and notes.

             Councilman Shakeenab made a motion to approve Resolution 61-2025-26;
             Councilman Zacharias seconded the motion. A voice vote was taken and the
             motion passed.

7.   Public Comment
     (allows 3 persons; 5 minutes each)
      There was no public comment
8.   Attorney Client Privilege
      The Committee went into Attorney Client Privilege Session at 4:54 pm
     A.   Motion to defend and indemnify Chief Freddie Montgomery regarding Birkes,
          Collins, Musumeci, Paso, Stevens and International Association of Fire Fighters
          Local 3180, Clarksville Professional Fire Fighters Association v City of Clarksville
          TN and Chief Freddie Montgomery
9.   Public Discussion and Vote
      The Committee came back into regular session at 5:20 pm
     A.   Motion to defend and indemnify Chief Freddie Montgomery
             Councilman Lovato made a motion to defend and indemnify Chief Freddie
             Montgomery; Councilman Streetman seconded the meeting. A voice vote was
             taken and the motion passed.
10. Adjournment
      The meeting was adjourned at 5:21 pm
